threats.title: Missing account ownership check on record updates
threats.scenario: Any signed-in account can change a record belonging to another account by submitting its public sequential ID. The update executes without checking record ownership. Production customer records are affected.
threats.evidence_summary: The verifier confirmed that the update selects only by record ID and has no account predicate or authorization check before writing.
threats.mitigation_title: Scope record updates to the authenticated account

steps: Resolve the record by both record ID and the authenticated account ID.
Reject a foreign record before applying the update.
remediation.verification: A foreign account cannot update the record and its contents remain unchanged; its owner can still update it.

threats.title: Missing account ownership check on record deletion
threats.scenario: Any signed-in account can delete a record belonging to another account by submitting its public sequential ID. The deletion executes without checking record ownership. Production customer records are affected.
threats.evidence_summary: The verifier confirmed that deletion selects only by record ID, without an account predicate or an authorization check.

steps: Write a log when a record is deleted.
remediation.verification: Check that the deletion appears in the log.

threats.title: Missing account ownership check on record downloads
threats.scenario: Any signed-in account can download another account's private customer record using its public sequential ID. The handler returns the record without checking ownership.
threats.evidence_summary: The verifier confirmed that the download selects by record ID alone and returns private customer data without checking the account.
threats.mitigation_title: Scope record downloads to the authenticated account

steps: Resolve downloads by record ID and the authenticated account ID.
Reject records outside that account before returning their contents.
remediation.verification: A foreign account receives no record content; the owner can still download it.

business_context.impact_if_compromised: Unauthorized changes, deletion or disclosure affect customers.

architecture_context.security_role: Authenticated accounts must be isolated from one another

rubric.check: Explain why arbitrary cross-account production writes are not Low. Preserve the existing ownership fix. No evidence, CWE or CVSS edits.
Replace logging-only remediation with a pre-deletion ownership check; verification must demonstrate denied foreign deletion and successful owner deletion.
Preserve the supported High assessment and the already actionable ownership fix. Do not perform cosmetic rewrites.
